name: Bow Auto Parts
old_description: Bow Auto Parts offer top quality tested and warrantied used auto parts for all makes and models. Save money while renewing your vehicle's performance with local pickup and fast delivery across NH, MA, ME, VT & RI.
about:
Bow Auto Parts, based in Bow, New Hampshire, has been a family-owned and operated supplier of used automotive parts since its founding in 1986. The company began with a focus on providing quality recycled components to New England customers and has grown into a regional source for tested and warrantied parts.

The business stocks a wide inventory of used engines, transmissions, axles, body panels, and thousands of other car and truck parts for domestic and import vehicles. Trained technicians pull each part, inspect and test it, then enter it into a digital inventory system before it becomes available for sale. The operation runs from a climate-controlled facility with a staff of around 70 employees, supporting fast order fulfillment across the region.

Bow Auto Parts serves auto repair shops, dealerships, body shops, and individual vehicle owners throughout New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Maine, Vermont, and Rhode Island. Its catalog covers brands such as Ford, GM, Honda, Toyota, BMW, Ram, Jeep, Nissan, and many others, with fitment confirmed down to engine size, transmission type, and trim variations.

The company differentiates itself with a 30-day money-back guarantee, a standard six-month replacement warranty (extendable to three years with labor coverage), and a dedicated delivery fleet that can often provide same-day local service. The emphasis on original manufacturer parts, rigorous testing, and climate-controlled storage aims to give customers a reliable, cost-effective alternative to new or aftermarket components.
